message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: leaf picking poppy fruit (罂粟果) and planting in own field. Then police found and removed 782 mature poppy plants. The defendant voluntarily surrendered and confessed.

The crime: illegal cultivation of poppy, which is a narcotic plant. Under Chinese criminal law, "非法种植毒品原植物罪" (illegal cultivation of drug raw material plants). The label used earlier in examples: "非法种植毒品原植物". Indeed earlier example: "非法种植毒品原植物". So the charge is that.

Check if any other charges: maybe "非法种植罂粟" is the same. No other crimes like "走私" etc. So single charge.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法种植毒品原植物<eoa>
